description:
Inspect an IP address in one call: whether it is using a VPN or proxy (`vpn`:
true, false, or null when there is no privacy data), its location (city, region,
country) and a sanctions screen of that country (`country_screen`, the same result as
screen_country; null when the location is unknown). One request, where detect_vpn
and geolocate_ip are one each. `lists`: optional comma-separated list slugs for the
country screen (add `fatf` for FATF's lists). `ref`: optional reference of your own,
echoed and recorded on the audit trail.
name: inspect_ip
title: Inspect an IP address
